intro: This page lists official UGC-DEB Online MBA providers that are based in Uttar Pradesh and published on College Decision. Fifteen universities are on the list for 2026, taken from the Commission’s 2026-27 entitled and recognised lists, not from aggregator directories.

If you are comparing the best Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh, start with recognition, then check fees, duration and specialisations on the university’s own online portal. The table below can help you shortlist; it does not replace the official admission notice.

sections.h2: Best Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: A useful first filter is the official UGC-DEB list for the current session. Twelve of these universities are on the 2026-27 entitled list, which means they may offer online programmes while they meet the prescribed NAAC or NIRF criteria. [Teerthanker Mahaveer University](/colleges/teerthanker-mahaveer-university-tmu-uttar-pradesh-moradabad), [Subharti University](/colleges/subharti-university-uttar-pradesh-meerut) and [JIIT Noida](/colleges/jaypee-institute-of-information-technology-jiit-uttar-pradesh-noida) appear instead on the recognised, or eligible, list, and JIIT’s recognition window is only from August 2026 to February 2027.

The list includes both public universities, such as [Lucknow University](/colleges/lucknow-university-lu-uttar-pradesh-lucknow), [CSJM University, Kanpur](/colleges/chhatrapati-shahu-ji-maharaj-university-csjm-university-uttar-pradesh-kanpur), [Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut](/colleges/chaudhary-charan-singh-university-uttar-pradesh-meerut) and [DDU Gorakhpur University](/colleges/deen-dayal-upadhyay-gorakhpur-university-uttar-pradesh-gorakhpur), and private universities such as [Sharda University Online](/colleges/sharda-university-online-uttar-pradesh-noida), [GLA Online](/colleges/gla-online-uttar-pradesh-agra), [Bennett University](/colleges/bennett-university-uttar-pradesh-greater-noida) and [Integral University](/colleges/integral-university-uttar-pradesh-lucknow). Open a college profile for the campus record, then confirm the live Online MBA page before you pay a fee.

The official online programmes we checked are two-year, four-semester degrees. Graduation from a recognised university is the usual eligibility; the published cut-off is not the same everywhere. Bennett asks for 50 per cent, CSJMU for 50 per cent with a 5 per cent relaxation for SC and ST candidates, CCSU for 45 per cent, and Galgotias for 55 per cent in a three-year bachelor’s degree.

Where the university published a clear official fee, the programme totals on this list currently run from ₹48,500 at Dr B R Ambedkar University, Agra, and ₹52,500 at DDU Gorakhpur, through ₹66,000 tuition at CSJMU and ₹67,000 at Mangalayatan, up to ₹1.18 lakh at NIU, ₹1.75 lakh at JIIT and ₹2.10 lakh at Bennett. We have not quoted a Galgotias fee because the official brochure and the current website table disagree. Application, exam or registration charges may sit on top of a tuition figure, so read the fee note on the college profile and on the university site.

People often look up top Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh 2026 on ranking websites. Those lists frequently mix national brands, diplomas and city tags that are not the university’s seat. On this page, a college appears only if it is an official UP provider with a published Online MBA profile. Several national UGC-entitled universities also offer an Online MBA that you can study from Uttar Pradesh; they are not listed here as UP colleges. Compare them on the all-India [Online MBA college list](/online-mba-colleges).

faqs.question: How many official Online MBA colleges are there in Uttar Pradesh?
faqs.answer: This page currently lists 15 published universities in Uttar Pradesh with an official UGC-DEB Online MBA. That count is of live College Decision profiles, not of every name that appears on a third-party “online MBA in UP” directory. The official 2026-27 entitled and recognised lists remain the reference if a new session is published.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a UGC-DEB entitled and a recognised Online MBA in Uttar Pradesh?
faqs.answer: Entitled higher educational institutions may offer online programmes while they meet the prescribed NAAC or NIRF criteria. Recognised, or eligible, institutions have a stated recognition period. On this list, TMU, Subharti and JIIT are on the recognised 2026-27 list, and JIIT’s window is only August 2026 to February 2027. Check the current UGC-DEB notice before you apply.

faqs.question: What is the fee range for Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh?
faqs.answer: Official programme totals we could verify run from ₹48,500 at Dr B R Ambedkar University, Agra, to ₹2,10,000 at Bennett University. Several public universities are clustered between about ₹52,000 and ₹66,000. These figures come from the university’s official online site or CDOE fee table and may exclude a separate application fee. We have not published a Galgotias fee because two official sources disagree; confirm any figure on the university portal for the intake you are joining.

faqs.question: Can I do an Online MBA from a university that is not based in Uttar Pradesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. An Online MBA from a UGC-DEB entitled or recognised university can usually be studied from anywhere in India, including Uttar Pradesh. Those national providers are not listed as Uttar Pradesh colleges on this page. Use the all-India Online MBA college list if you want to compare them, and still match the university name on the official UGC-DEB list.

faqs.question: Do I need CAT or a state entrance exam for these Online MBA programmes?
faqs.answer: The official pages we checked generally admit graduates who meet a marks cut-off, rather than requiring CAT or a state MBA exam as a mandatory entrance. Some universities may still use their own test, interview or document verification. Follow the admission steps on the university’s Centre for Distance and Online Education portal, not a third-party counselling brochure.

faqs.question: Are Online MBA degrees from these Uttar Pradesh universities valid?
faqs.answer: An Online MBA is treated as equivalent to a regular degree when the university is entitled or recognised by UGC-DEB for that programme in the relevant session, and when you complete the degree as prescribed. Always match the university and the programme name on the current official UGC-DEB list, generate a DEB ID if the university asks for one, and keep the admission offer and fee receipt.
